它们的地下群落数量众多，遍布整片大陆，但目前为止还没有造成过什么问题。目前尚不清楚它们是在寻找着地表上的什么东西，或是为了躲避地下的什么东西而逃出。
texts.en:
Since settling on [Root.GetName], we have noted increased arthropod activity. Specifically, tiny colony-building insects designated "Myrmeku" have become unexpectedly productive.

Their underground colonies are spread across the continent in great numbers, but until now they have never caused an issue. It is unknown if they are searching for something above ground or fleeing from something beneath.

label.zh: 把密弥库蚁写进知识宝库。
label.en: Update "Myrmeku" in the Vaults of Knowledge.

texts.zh: 微小昆虫的集群突然集体爆发，席卷了整个[myrmeku_planet.GetName]大地。
texts.en: Swarms of tiny insects have sprung into action, sweeping across the [myrmeku_planet.GetName] landscape.

texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]遭受到了残暴的攻击！由于太过靠近密弥库蚁的群落，它们被蚁拥而上。这些微小的昆虫钻进了[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的框架内，这些受害者很快就被击溃了。

落败的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]在一瞬间就被肢解了，但关于这种昆虫的行为目的没有记录下任何有意义的信息。的磁性外骨骼凹凸不平的表面会破坏我们的内部电路，当两只密弥库蚁接触时，它们会产生微小的电火花；这两种情况都可能导致灾难性的系统故障。

以这种方式损失[Owner.GetColonistPlural]拖慢了这颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的发展速度。我们必须采取些行动。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] on [Root.GetName] have been viscously attacked! Venturing too close to a Myrmeku colony, they were swarmed. As the tiny insects entered openings in the [Owner.GetColonistPlural]' frames, the victims were quickly overwhelmed.

The fallen [Owner.GetColonistPlural] were immediately disassembled, but no conclusive data was collected as to the insects' purpose. The craggy surface of the Myrmeku's magnetic exoskeletons damage our internal circuitry, and when two Myrmeku touch, they create a tiny electrical spark; both of which may cause catastrophic failure.

Losing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] this way has slowed down the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s development rate. Something must be done.

texts.zh:
密弥库蚁以迅雷不及掩耳之势在我们的定居点附近建造了数座大型建筑。他们的攻击已经不再局限于周边地区了，而是开始出现在居住区域中。

大量可供解剖的对象揭示了密弥库蚁对我们感兴趣的令人不安的原因：这种昆虫吃我们存储芯片的绝缘材料。

这种致命性对受害者只是暂时的，因为记忆电路可以替换并恢复备份。然而，替换这些部件就会让新[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的建造放慢。
texts.en:
With astounding speed, the Myrmeku have built several sprawling structures close to our settlement. Their attacks are no longer limited to the perimeter, but have also begun inside housing structures.

The large number of subjects available for autopsy has revealed the disturbing reason why the Myrmeku are interested in us: The insects consume the insulation material of our memory chips.

This is only fatal for the victim in the short term, as memory circuits can be replaced and backups restored. However, replacing the parts means delays for the construction of new [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

label.zh: 把这个行星上的生命清空。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的殖民建筑进行了完全的密封以避免密弥库蚁进入。

所有新旧建筑的入口都增加可以磁化的金属条带来捕获密弥库蚁，但在野外[Owner.GetColonistPlural]仍会遭受攻击而损失。
texts.en:
The colony buildings on [Root.GetName] were completely sealed off to keep the Myrmeku insects out.

The entrances of both new and existing buildings were outfitted with metallic strips that can be magnetized to trap the Myrmeku, but [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are still being lost to attacks in the field.

texts.zh:
将我们的记忆芯片封装在额外保护的外壳中的升级套件已经在进行开发和现场测试。

不幸的是，密弥库蚁的下颚足够强壮，只要有足够的时间和数量，它们可以吃掉任何可用的材料。
texts.en:
Upgrade kits to house our memory chips in an additional protective shell have been developed and field tested.

Unfortunately, the Myrmeku mandibles are strong enough to eat through any available material, given enough time and numbers.

texts.zh:
为了杀光密弥库蚁，我们派出了巡逻队寻找它们的巢穴。地表的结构很容易通过燃烧和爆破来摧毁，但地下的群落实在过深，难以进行完全的清理。

而在行动过程中我们甚至失去了更多的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
texts.en:
To kill off the Myrmeku, patrols were sent to scan for nests. It was easy to destroy the structures above ground with fire and explosives, but the underground colonies were buried deep enough that they were unfeasible to completely eradicate.

We lost even more [Owner.GetColonistPlural] during the operation.

texts.zh:
为了控制密弥库蚁，我们在它们的巢穴附近建造了生物捕获器。地表的结构很容易进行收获，但地下的群落实在过深，难以进行完全的清理。

而在行动过程中我们甚至失去了更多的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
texts.en:
To control the Myrmeku, bio harvesters were established near their colonies. The structures above ground were easily harvested, but the underground colonies were buried too deep to completely eradicate.

We lost even more [Owner.GetColonistPlural] during the operation.

label.zh: 我们需要更好的解决方案。

texts.zh:
至今为止，为解决密弥库蚁问题的努力尚未得到成功。这些昆虫依旧数量惊人，袭扰着[Root.GetName]各地，殖民地的交通各种活动深受其害。我们分析子例程通过对未来预期的模拟得出了以下方案。

应对方案A：通过向远离殖民地的区域空投记忆体绝缘材料来将密弥库蚁引走，并回收利用损坏的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。

应对方案B：研究这些密弥库蚁，寻找到他们残暴本性的可能利用方式。
texts.en:
Efforts so far have not put an end to the Myrmeku problem. The insects still crawl across [Root.GetName] in immense numbers, making travel and off-colony operations difficult. Our analysis subroutine has concluded its simulation of potential futures with the following approaches.

Approach A: Distract the Myrmeku by airdropping memory insulation material far off from our colony and recycle the fallen [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

Approach B: Study the Myrmeku to see if we can find a way to turn their vigorous activity into something useful.

texts.zh: 对[myrmeku_planet.GetName]上的密弥库蚁进行研究，以厘清其残暴的行为是否能变害为宝。
texts.en: A study of the Myrmeku on [myrmeku_planet.GetName] to determine if their vigorous activity can be turned into something useful.

texts.zh:
我们对密弥库蚁的研究完成了。把校准过的磁体放置在它们的聚落入口附近时，这些昆虫的磁性外骨骼就会释放出我们能够利用的电能。

这些研究还表明，密弥库蚁会依照当地磁场移动，因此在我们的记忆芯片加装去磁保护壳就可以避免受其攻击。
texts.en:
Our study of the Myrmeku has concluded. When calibrated magnets were placed around the entrances of their colonies, the magnetism in the insect exoskeletons generated electricity that we could harness.

The study also showed that the Myrmeku move according to local magnetic fields, so installing a demagnetized protective shell around our memory chips should be enough to protect them.

texts.zh:
杀死[Root.GetName]上所有有机生物的准备已经完成。

行动过程中，在轨道上观看[Root.GetPlanetMoon]让我们有机会得以欣赏地表有机复杂性的降低。
texts.en:
Everything has been prepared for the cleansing of biological life on [Root.GetName].

Observing the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] from orbit during the event will give us an opportunity to appreciate the reduction in organic complexity on the surface.
